WPG.head: A slightly uphill night for the Jets
WPG.body: Even though Winnipeg has home-ice advantage, Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Jets’ best way to tip it is a penalty kill that holds up.

ANA.head: The Ducks start a half-step ahead
ANA.body: Even though Winnipeg has home-ice advantage, Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. Still, it’s close: the Jets can make it interesting if their penalty kill holds up.

items.text: The Jets are newly without Josh Morrissey and Nino Niederreiter, and have had to make do without Connor Hellebuyck all season. Stuart Skinner is expected to start.
The Ducks have been without Troy Terry all season.
Kyle Connor is set to play his 700th NHL game.
Mikael Granlund is one goal from 200.
